items.name: The Faceted Ward
items.description: A warped disc of verdigris bronze, the metal buckled and re-set so many times the original form is barely legible. A face was once pressed into the front — mouth open, eyes shut. Most of the features have been beaten flat. It turns a blow poorly. It is better than nothing.
